entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: An information element that may be included by the network under specific conditions related to back-off timer and ESM cause.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: An information element containing timer value for back-off procedures.

entities.name: ESM cause #26 insufficient resources
entities.description: ESM cause value indicating insufficient resources.

entities.name: Inclusion condition for re-attempt indicator
entities.description: Condition specifying that re-attempt indicator IE may only be included if back-off timer value IE is included and ESM cause is not #26.

relations.description: Specifies the condition under which the re-attempt indicator IE may be included.
Condition requires the presence of back-off timer value IE.
Condition requires that ESM cause is not #26 insufficient resources.
